expect.summary: Family signup detected. 7 phone items plus the 4 family items all present. First charge goes through.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, I'm Maya Chen. I'm calling to sign up my mother, Lin Chen. She can't use apps anymore.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Of course. GoGo lets your mother book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no app. She calls or texts us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip and can update you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: That's exactly what she needs.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: The Premium plan is $59.00 per month, billed monthly to the card on the account.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, $59 a month works.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: The membership automatically renews each month unless you or your mother cancel.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I understand.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Either of you can cancel any time with no fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in the account settings.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our toll-free number is 1-855-464-6872 and our email is support@gogograndparent.com, for cancelling or questions.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Got it, I have both.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration, not court.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Understood.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Because you're signing up on your mother's behalf, you are also responsible for all fees and charges on the account, jointly with her.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I understand I'm responsible for the charges too.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Can you confirm you have the authority to approve recurring charges on your mother's behalf?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes. I have power of attorney for her, and I'm authorized to approve the recurring charges.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: The arbitration agreement and class action waiver bind both you and your mother.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, that's fine.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: And your mother has the right to receive information about the service directly from us at any time, not only through you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Good, she'd like that.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Maya, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Mastercard ending in 2290 $59.00 today and every month until it's cancelled?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I authorize it.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thank you. We'll send the written confirmation to your email before the first charge.
